name: deterministic_helper
title: Flowork Deterministic Helper (Google Harness² c7)
description: Google Harness² c7 Deterministic Helper Engine: Synthesizes and executes local deterministic scripts (Python, Bash, Node.js, Rust) in isolated .FL_BIN/scratch/helpers/ space. Offloads heavy regex matching, log parsing, numerical aggregation, and JSON/CSV conversions away from LLM tokens, returning only concise aggregated outputs with Exit Code 0 verification.
author: Flowork Sovereign Core

code.description: Executable script code performing deterministic data transformation or log analysis.

input_files.description: Optional file paths or patterns that the script will analyze or transform.

arguments.description: Optional CLI arguments string or JSON payload passed to the script.

max_output_chars.description: Strict token preservation ceiling (default: 4000 characters). Automatically applies Head-Tail preservation if output exceeds limit.

task_description.description: Brief description of the deterministic transformation being performed.

keywords.description: Mandatory technical domain keywords in English.

reason.description: MANDATORY ON EVERY TOOL CALL: Clear, concise technical rationale explaining WHY you are calling this tool right now.

fl_brain_ref.description: Optional reference to .fl_brain memory path or 'fresh_solution' or 'none'.
